name: ShowSky_6
short_caption: The robot raises its right hand up toward the sky as if pointing upward or waving, then lowers it back to its side.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral posture and raises its right arm high up and to the right, with its palm open and facing outward as if pointing to the sky or waving at a distance. It holds this upward-reaching pose briefly, looking slightly up and toward the right side. Finally, it smoothly lowers the right arm back down to its side, returning to its neutral, resting position.
safety_notes: The right arm sweeps upward and outward to its full extension, requiring clear physical clearance on the robot's right side.
